procedure: Access Epson Web Config at http://[printer-ip]
No login required by default (unless administrator password set)
Navigate to Product Security tab or System Administration
Select 'Export All Settings' or 'Backup Configuration'
Choose settings to backup:
- Network settings (IP, WiFi, protocols)
- Email server configuration (SMTP settings)
- Scan destinations (network folders, email addresses)
- Device settings (paper, timeout, power save)
Click 'Export' button
Configuration file downloads: WFC5890_Settings_2024-11-16.epson or .xml
Store backup file securely - contains network and email credentials
Recommended: Backup before firmware updates or major network changes
systemBackup.location: Downloads to local computer via web browser
notes: Backup file may contain SMTP passwords in encrypted form
Some advanced security settings exported separately
Address book (contacts/destinations) included in system backup
Consumable counters (ink levels) NOT backed up - hardware tracked

procedure: Access Epson Web Config at http://[printer-ip]

Navigate to Product Security > Import/Export
Click 'Browse' or 'Choose File' under Import section
Select previously exported configuration file (.epson or .xml)

Wait 30-60 seconds for import to complete
Device may reboot automatically to apply settings
After reboot (approximately 1-2 minutes), verify network connectivity
Access web interface again to confirm settings
Print network status sheet to verify configuration
Test device functions: print, scan, email
prerequisites: Valid backup file from same or compatible Epson model

Network access to device via Ethernet or WiFi
Administrator password if authentication is enabled
notes: IP address may change if backup had different network configuration
Administrator password restored from backup file
Scan destinations and address book automatically restored
Ink levels NOT affected by restore (hardware-based counters)
If restore fails, device retains current settings - safe to retry

requirements: SMTP mail server address and port
smtpConfiguration: Access Epson Web Config at http://[printer-ip]
Navigate to Scan/Copy > Email Server Settings
Enter SMTP Server Address: smtp.office365.com or smtp.gmail.com
Select Authentication: Off, PLAIN, LOGIN, CRAM-MD5, or DIGEST-MD5
For Office 365/Gmail: Select LOGIN or PLAIN with TLS
Enter SMTP User Name (full email address for most servers)
Enter SMTP Password (use app password for Gmail with 2FA)
Set Sender's Email Address (From address - must be valid)
Select Security: None, SSL/TLS (465), or STARTTLS (587)
Maximum Email Size: Set limit or leave default (10 MB typical)
Sender's Name: Friendly name shown in emails (e.g., 'Office Scanner')
Use 'Send Test Email' to verify configuration
authenticationSetup: Office 365: smtp.office365.com, port 587, STARTTLS, LOGIN auth, full email@domain.com
Gmail: smtp.gmail.com, port 587, STARTTLS, enable 2FA and create app password
Exchange on-premise: Internal server (mail.company.local), port 25 or 587
Generic SMTP: Check with IT department for server, port, authentication method
For SSL (port 465): Select SSL/TLS security option
For STARTTLS (port 587): Select STARTTLS security option
Note: Some servers require sender address to match authenticated account
testProcedure: In Email Server Settings: Click 'Send Test Email' button
Check recipient inbox (delivery may take 1-2 minutes)
If failed, touchscreen shows error code or web interface shows failure reason
Common errors: Authentication failed, Connection timeout, Relay access denied
From device touchscreen: Scan > Email > Enter address or select contact > Start

requirements: Network file share (SMB/CIFS or FTP server)
Valid user credentials with write permissions
smbConfiguration: Navigate to Scan/Copy > Shared Folder Settings
Click 'Add' to create new scan destination
Enter Destination Name (shown on touchscreen): Accounting Files
Enter User Name: DOMAIN\\scanuser or SERVERNAME\\scanner
- File Format: PDF (recommended), JPEG, TIFF, Multi-TIFF, Searchable PDF
- File Name: Prefix (Scan_), Date/Time format, Counter
- Color Mode: Auto, Color, Grayscale, Black & White
- Document Size: Auto-detect or specify (A4, Letter, etc.)
Click 'Test Connection' to verify access and permissions
ftpConfiguration: Access Web Config > Scan/Copy > FTP Server Settings
Enter Destination Name: FTP Document Archive
Enter Server Address: ftp.company.com or IP address
Enter Username and Password for FTP account
Directory Path on FTP server: /scans/incoming or /public/docs
Passive Mode: Enable if behind firewall (recommended)
Set file format and scan settings same as SMB
Note: Standard FTP not encrypted - consider FTPS if available
authenticationSetup: Local account: Use COMPUTERNAME\\username or just username
- NTFS permissions: Modify or Write on target folder
Test manually: Try creating file in folder from another PC using same credentials
Best practice: Use dedicated service account (not personal accounts)
For user-authenticated scanning: Enable 'Require Authentication' in scan job settings

- Resolution: 200 dpi (normal), 300 dpi (high), 600 dpi (photo)
- Color Mode: Color, Grayscale, Black & White, Auto

- Duplex (2-Sided): Off (1-sided) or On (2-sided)
Load document in ADF (up to 50 sheets) or on scanner glass

Wait for scan completion message

supportedFormats: PDF (single or multi-page, default and recommended)
JPEG (single page, good for photos and images)
notes: FAT32 has 4GB single file limit - use exFAT for very large scan jobs

PDF recommended for documents, JPEG for photos
Always use 'Eject' or 'Safely Remove' before removing USB to prevent corruption
USB drive should be empty or have plenty of free space
